The championship began on 15 May 1949 and ended on 4 September 1949. [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]] were the [[1948 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]], however, they were defeated in the provincial championship. [[Tipperary GAA|Tipperary]] won the title following a 3–11 to 0–3 defeat of [[Laois GAA|Laois]].{{cite web|url=http://www.laoisgaa.utvinternet.ie/hurling2003/tipperary/1949.htm |title=Happy
